items.title: Experience the magic of Kosovo from anywhere with Street View
items.summary: 这篇内容聚焦「AI 技术演进和可复用工程实践」。原文摘要显示：Google Maps brings Street View to Kosovo, offering a virtual tour of its vibrant cities, UNESCO World Heritage site, and natural beauty.
items.insightText: 先快速判断它是否包含可复用方法、架构或工程经验，再决定是否进入日报深读。

items.title: A Safe Path to Open Weights
items.summary: 这篇内容聚焦「AI 技术演进和可复用工程实践」。原文摘要显示：Abstract: Safe open-weight models are public goods, as they put AI development and safety work in many hands and make training choices inspectable. Open models also carry real misuse risks, and release is irreversible. …
items.insightText: 重点看任务拆分、工具编排、验证闭环和可复用工程抽象，判断能否迁移到 Auto-Research / Agent Coding 链路。
